articles.title: Poland, Ukraine slam Russian strikes near border as 'escalation'
articles.summary: Poland and Ukraine denounced on Sept. 13 Russian strikes close to the Polish border that hit a Warsaw-bound train near a frontier checkpoint just after another train carrying several EU officials and British ex-PM Boris Johnson passed through.

articles.title: Cuban dance teacher ordered EU sabotage attacks from Russia
articles.summary: In 2024, a Cuban man coordinated a series of arson attacks in four EU countries while operating on behalf of Russian intelligence services. DW Investigations tracked him back to a Latin dance studio in Russia.
